title: Two Of Us
lyrics_synced:
[00:11.01] Two of us riding nowhere.
[00:14.31] Spending someone's
[00:16.51] hard earned pay.
[00:20.92] You and me Sunday driving.
[00:24.22] Not arriving,
[00:26.42] on our way back home.
[00:32.75] We're on our way home!
[00:36.05] We're on our way home!
[00:39.36] We're goin' home!
[00:42.39] Two of us sending postcards,
[00:45.69] writing letters, on my wall.
[00:52.29] You and me burning matches,
[00:55.60] lifting latches,
[00:57.80] on our way back home.
[01:04.13] We're on our way home!
[01:07.43] We're on our way home!
[01:10.73] We're goin' home!
[01:15.96] You and I have memories,
[01:20.37] longer than the road,
[01:23.12] that stretches out ahead.
[01:29.17] Two of us wearing raincoats,
[01:32.48] standing solo in the sun.
[01:39.08] You and me chasing paper,
[01:42.39] getting nowhere,
[01:44.59] on our way back home.
[01:50.92] We're on our way home!
[01:54.22] We're on our way home!
[01:57.52] We're goin' home!

[02:07.16] longer than the road,
[02:09.91] that stretches out ahead.
[02:15.96] Two of us riding nowhere.
